organizations.name: 211 (United Way)
organizations.what_they_help_with: The front door to local help: emergency rent and utility assistance, food, shelter, healthcare access, crisis support.

organizations.name: Benefits.gov
organizations.eligibility: Everyone — screening tool shows what you may qualify for
organizations.what_they_help_with: One questionnaire to find government benefits you may be owed: SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, WIC, LIHEAP, and more.

organizations.name: Operation HOPE
organizations.what_they_help_with: Credit and money management coaching, small business development, and homeownership preparation in underserved communities.

organizations.name: SBA — Minority Business Development
organizations.what_they_help_with: Small business loans, 8(a) minority contracting certification, free local mentoring through SCORE and Small Business Development Centers.

organizations.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
organizations.eligibility: Anyone with a problem with a bank, lender, or debt collector
organizations.what_they_help_with: Complaints about lending discrimination, predatory loans, debt collection abuse — companies must respond, usually within 15 days.
